name: hybrid
rationale: Reverse comparison for record 110: the released retrieval bundle (policy 3361ed13) was gated on a corpus where only 76 of 333 documents were searchable (record 109). This candidate restates every released key and sets it back to the repository default, so the runner compares baseline = released bundle against candidate = bundle removed on the really indexed corpus. A negative delta of the candidate confirms the released policy end to end. This file is never to be submitted or released.
